name: Void Gauntlet
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
